name: Radomsko County (Poland)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of yellow and red, charged at the centre with the emblem of the county arms: a crowned eagle half red on the yellow and half black on the red, bearing a yellow letter R.
history: The current flag was established by resolution No. LXXVII/522/2024 of the county council of 24 April 2024, replacing a first version adopted on 5 September 2000.

features.role: crowned half-red, half-black eagle with the letter R from the county arms
